description: This file defines a PHP trait 'RunAction' that provides methods for executing console actions with verbosity control, status updates, and handling of content length. It is part of a command-line interface utility within a documentation generation project.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of the content string, using 'mb_strlen' if available for multibyte support.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Performs a console action with a title, manages verbosity, writes status indicators, and executes a provided closure. Handles exceptions and updates status accordingly.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Outputs a status message with appropriate padding, based on verbosity level.
